package wrongreferencehook

import (
	"example.com/ridu-gate1/field"
	"example.com/ridu-gate1/operation"
)

var _ = field.Relationship("owner", "users").Hooks(field.Hooks[operation.ID]{
	BeforeChange: []field.Transform[operation.ID]{
		func(operation.WriteContext, operation.Value[string]) (operation.Change[string], error) {
			return operation.Change[string]{}, nil
		},
	},
})
